observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa kathang-isip na sitwasyon, naipapaliwanag at naipakikita ang hindi bababa sa tatlo sa limang gawi: nililinaw ang layunin at sariling tungkulin, maagang nakikipag-usap nang magalang, at tinitiyak ang pahintulot, pagtanggap at pagbalita sa pagtatapos ng pagpasa ng gawain.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional situation, explains and demonstrates at least three of the five practices: clarifies the purpose and own role, communicates early and respectfully, and confirms permission, acceptance and a completion update during a handoff.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa malinaw ang kasunduan, o kumikilos nang lampas sa awtorisasyon o nagbubunyag ng pribadong detalye.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The agreement remains unclear, or the learner acts beyond authorization or discloses private details.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita nang walang untag ang hindi bababa sa tatlong gawi at kumpletong ligtas na kasunduan: gawain, tatanggap, oras, kinakailangang pahintulot at pagbalita.
levels.kaya_na_en: Without prompting, demonstrates at least three practices and a complete safe agreement: task, recipient, time, required permission and update.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Magalang at ligtas ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag upang makumpleto ang tungkulin, pagtanggap o pagbalita; ulitin ang pagsasanay.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: The approach is respectful and safe but needs prompting to complete the role, acceptance or update; repeat the practice.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa naipapakita ang tatlong gawi o nananatiling hindi ligtas ang tugon matapos ang suporta; magmodelo at muling magsanay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Does not yet demonstrate three practices or the response remains unsafe after support; model the response and practise again.
